questions.q: Why can't you rely on the COM port number?
options: Windows forbids access by port number
The number changes after a reboot
It's always COM1
Linux doesn't support COM
questions.explain: Identical boards share one VID/PID, and the number changes after a reboot. Find the drone by craft_name inside the CLI.

questions.q: What does exit noreboot do in Betaflight 4.5.x?
options: Exits without rebooting
Reboots anyway
Saves the settings
Erases the flash
questions.explain: The noreboot flag started working in newer versions. To peek at a value, just close the port.

questions.q: After set + save the value turned out different. Why?
options: The port was busy with another program during the write
The firmware corrected the value
The script is broken
A bad USB cable
questions.explain: Betaflight corrects incompatible combinations on boot. Rule: after save, re-read every changed value with get.

questions.q: What should the script do right after save?
options: Send the diff again to confirm the write
Find the port by craft_name again
Exit the CLI
Enable dshot_bidir
questions.explain: After a reboot the COM port may get a different number.

questions.q: Why store a diff and not a dump?
options: A dump can't be saved to a text file
A diff is only the differences from defaults
A diff is shorter in bytes
dump doesn't work
questions.explain: A diff is readable and portable; a dump forces old defaults as explicit values when you update.

questions.q: What is safe to automate with a CLI script?
options: Exporting diff all and verifying values after save
Picking PIDs by pilot feel after every flight
Deciding whether a drone is cleared to fly
Flashing the bootloader instead of DFU
questions.explain: Routine work with a verifiable result — yes; decisions and risky operations — no.

questions.q: Moving a diff from an old major version to a new one:
options: Always works unchanged
Is impossible under any circumstances
Is done only via dump
Requires checking: setting names and meanings change
questions.explain: Settings get renamed and changed between versions; you check a diff instead of pasting it blindly.

questions.q: How does a script enter the Betaflight CLI?
options: It presses the BOOT button on the board
It sends the MAVLink command COMMAND_LONG
It sends the # character to the serial port
It opens the CLI tab in the configurator
questions.explain: The # character puts the firmware into the CLI; after that, commands are plain text.
